en-US.AI 助手在 Chrome 扩展内运行: The AI reader runs inside the Chrome extension
en-US.请安装独立钱包扩展，从扩展菜单打开钱包。此网页仅预览界面，不会发送银行数据或保存: Install the standalone extension and open the wallet from its menu. This web preview cannot send bank data or store API keys.
en-US.在此填写 API 密钥，不要发送到聊天: Enter the API key here, not in chat
en-US.密钥只存于本次 Chrome 会话，不随钱包导出；重启浏览器后需重新填写。连接只: The key stays in this Chrome session and is excluded from exports. Enter it again after restarting Chrome. Connecting saves settings; the first parse validates the key.
en-US.先从“银行连接”打开官网并登录。助手只读取显示在页面上的内容，登录、认证与翻页加: Open the bank from Bank connections and sign in. The reader uses visible content only. Sign-in, verification and page loading stay with the bank.
en-US.解析服务会收到上述余额、积分、优惠或交易片段。已屏蔽可识别的长号码和邮箱；请检查: The provider receives these balance, points, offer or transaction excerpts. Recognizable long numbers and email addresses are masked. Check for anything else you do not want to share.
en-US.允许将这些片段发送给 {0} 进行本次解析: Send these excerpts to {0} for this parse
en-US.任务已中断，请重新预览。已保存的数据不受影响。: Task interrupted. Preview again; saved data is unchanged.
en-US.{0} 项结果未通过证据校验，已排除。: {0} items failed evidence checks and were excluded.
en-US.模型结果不会自动覆盖钱包。请核对卡片归属、借贷符号、币种和积分池；共享积分按银行: Model results require review. Check card, debit/credit sign, currency and points pool. Shared points are deduplicated by bank, region and programme.
en-US.已打开建议页面。等待银行加载完毕后，继续预览。: Suggested page opened. Wait for it to load, then preview again.
en-US.选择银行页面，开始本轮采集: Select a bank page to start
en-US.请先在银行官网完成登录。: Sign in on the bank website first.
en-US.页面未显示已知卡片，请打开卡片详情。: No known card is visible. Open its details.
en-US.当前页面没有找到可解析的财务内容。: No readable financial content was found.
en-US.银行页面已改变，请重新预览。: The bank page changed. Preview again.
en-US.请选择该银行已登录的账户页。: Choose a signed-in account page for this bank.
en-US.正在解析，请等待或停止任务。: Parsing is in progress. Wait or stop the task.
en-US.模型密钥无效或没有权限。: The model API key is invalid or unauthorized.
en-US.模型服务限流，请稍后重试。: Model rate limit reached. Try again later.
en-US.模型响应超时，未更新钱包。: The model timed out. The wallet was not changed.
en-US.模型返回格式异常，未更新钱包。: The model returned an invalid format. The wallet was not changed.
en-US.模型返回内容过多，未更新钱包。: Model response too large. The wallet was not changed.
en-US.已达到本轮五页限制，请重新开始。: Five-page limit reached. Start a new round.
en-US.银行页面仍在加载，请稍后继续。: The bank page is still loading. Continue shortly.
en-US.操作未完成，已保留钱包数据。: The action did not complete. Wallet data was kept.
en-US.保存时浏览器会询问是否允许扩展访问 {0}。: When you save, the browser asks whether the extension may reach {0}.
en-US.删除后需要重新粘贴密钥才能使用 AI。: After deleting, paste a key again to use AI.
en-US.密钥只保存在本扩展的本地存储里，不同步、不写入备份、日志或诊断报告，只发送给你选: The key is kept only in this extension’s local storage. It is not synced or written to backups, logs or diagnostic reports, and is sent only to the provider you chose. After saving, only its first and last characters are shown.
en-US.密钥在浏览器扩展里添加：打开扩展里的钱包，进入设置。本页使用本机调试服务。: Add the key in the browser extension: open the wallet from the extension and go to Settings. This page uses the local development service.
en-US.密钥已保存，只存放在本扩展里。: Key saved. It stays in this extension only.
en-US.扩展还没有访问服务商的权限，请替换密钥并在弹窗里允许。: The extension can’t reach the provider yet. Replace the key and allow access in the prompt.
en-US.暂时连不上服务商，请稍后再试。: Couldn’t reach the provider. Try again shortly.
en-US.服务商拒绝了这个密钥，请检查是否复制完整或已过期。: The provider rejected this key. Check that it was copied in full and hasn’t expired.
en-US.服务商暂时限流，请稍后再测试。: The provider is limiting requests. Test again shortly.
en-US.没有获得访问服务商的权限，密钥未保存。: Access to the provider wasn’t allowed, so the key wasn’t saved.
en-US.聊天助手、卡片识别和 AI 补全银行数据都用这里的密钥直接调用服务商。不添加也能: Chat, card recognition and AI-assisted bank parsing call the provider directly with this key. Without one, the wallet works as usual, just without AI.
en-US.聊天助手需要先在设置里添加 AI 模型密钥，钱包其他功能不受影响。: Add an AI model key in Settings to use chat. The rest of the wallet works without it.
en-US.请先保存密钥并允许扩展访问服务商。: Save a key and allow access to the provider first.
en-US.这看起来不是有效的密钥，请检查后重新粘贴。: That doesn’t look like a valid key. Check it and paste again.
en-US.密钥已保存，但暂时没能连上服务商确认，请稍后点测试连接。: Key saved, but the provider couldn’t be reached to check it. Test the connection shortly.
en-US.服务商拒绝了模型密钥，请在设置里更换。: The provider rejected the model key. Replace it in Settings.
en-US.服务商暂时限流，请稍后再问。: The provider is limiting requests. Ask again shortly.
